systems.name: Launcher
systems.blurb: A single spinning Hogback wheel flings POLLEN and NECTAR up into the raised cell. Spin-up speed sets how far the ball flies.

systems.name: Ball path
systems.blurb: Panels and a servo that carry each ball from the intake up the ramp to the flywheel, one at a time.

systems.name: Intake
systems.blurb: Fast rollers and Gecko wheels grab balls from the floor. They have to be spinning to collect anything.

systems.name: Drivetrain
systems.blurb: Two Yellow Jacket motors drive each side through plastic chain, so the robot steers like a tank.

systems.name: Frame
systems.blurb: U-channel rails and brackets. Every hole sits on the goBILDA 8 mm grid, so parts bolt on anywhere.

systems.name: Power
systems.blurb: The 12 V battery that runs every motor and servo.

systems.name: Screws & bits
systems.blurb: Shafts, hubs, bearings, spacers and every screw that holds it together.
